about_us.title: About Us
about_us.subtitle: Discover the history and passion that drive Vako Club.
about_us.p1: At Vako Wine Club, we believe that wine is much more than a drink: it is culture, history, territory, and shared passion. We were born with the mission of bringing our readers and members closer to the fascinating universe of wine, combining knowledge, news, and unique experiences.
about_us.guide_desc: We are an exclusive guide that brings together informative articles on the latest news in the sector, interviews with wineries, tours of wine regions, wine reviews, and pairing recommendations designed for both amateurs and experts.
about_us.experiences_desc: In addition, we keep our community up to date with an agenda of events, tastings, and food and wine experiences that allow you to experience wine first-hand.
about_us.store_desc: And for those who want to take the experience a step further, we have our official store, where we carefully select labels that reflect the quality, authenticity, and diversity of the world of wine.
about_us.conclusion: At Vako Wine Club, we don't just talk about wine: we share it, we celebrate it, and we turn it into a lifestyle.
about_us.page_title: About Us - Vako Club | Culture and Passion for Wine
about_us.page_desc: Discover Vako Club: your exclusive guide to the fascinating universe of wine. Culture, history, unique experiences, and exceptional wines.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_p1: At Vako Wine Club, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.
privacy.s2_p1: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
privacy.s2_li1: Identity Data: Includes first name, last name, and username.
privacy.s2_li3: Technical Data: Includes IP address, login data, browser type and version, etc.
privacy.s2_li4: Profile Data: Includes your username and password, your interests, preferences, and feedback.
privacy.s2_li5: Usage Data: Includes information about how you use our website and services.
privacy.s3_p1: We use your personal data to:
privacy.s3_li1: Register you as a new customer.
privacy.s3_li3: Enable you to partake in forums, prize draws, or surveys.
privacy.s3_li4: Administer and protect our business and this website.
privacy.s3_li5: Deliver relevant website content and advertisements to you and measure or understand the effectiveness of the advertising we serve to you.
privacy.s4_p1: You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when websites set or access cookies. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of this website may become inaccessible or not function properly.
privacy.s5_p1: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorised way, altered or disclosed. We use the Supabase platform to ensure the security and management of authentication data.
privacy.s6_p1: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, such as the right to request access, correction, erasure, or restriction of your personal data.
privacy.s7_p1: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us through the information provided on our Contact page.
